title: Resend glow frame
description: A page-wide frame that opens a section: a hairline top edge with 24px rounded corners whose sides fade away downwards, and a soft grey light pooled under the top edge (centred or towards the end). Or a straight full-width hairline with the light under its middle.
notes: the light uses the theme's glow colour at low strength: strongest on dark themes
name: resend-frame

props.name: glow
props.description: where the light pools under the top edge

props.name: edge
props.description: rounded: a page-wide frame with rounded top corners · line: a straight full-width hairline (footer)
